footer.donationMessage: Blood donation is a noble and life-saving humanitarian contribution. RoktoBondhu connects blood recipients and voluntary donors across Bangladesh in emergency times.
footer.missionNote: Be a part of voluntary humanitarian action

seo.description: A trusted digital platform connecting blood donors and recipients across Bangladesh.

hero.headline: Find Blood Donors When Every Moment Matters
hero.supporting: Search for blood donors by blood group and location. Your small act of kindness can make a meaningful difference.

search.title: Search Blood Donors
search.subtitle: Select the required blood group and district to find matching donors
search.demoNotice: The platform is currently running in interactive demo mode. Real-time database connectivity will be connected in subsequent phases. No fabricated results are shown.

howItWorks.sectionSubtitle: Making blood donor discovery and coordination fast and orderly during emergencies
howItWorks.step1Desc: Search matching blood donors by selecting the required blood group and location (division, district).
howItWorks.step2Desc: Connect responsibly with eligible, available donors through the platform's supported communication flow.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Coordinate the donation at the hospital or blood bank safely with all concerned parties.

bloodGroups.sectionSubtitle: Click any blood group to learn which recipient groups can safely receive it
bloodGroups.donorCountNotice: Blood group compatibility is displayed according to established international transfusion guidelines.

becomeDonor.heading: A Single Donation Can Save a Life
becomeDonor.subheading: Regular voluntary blood donation saves precious lives. Join as a registered donor and become part of this humanitarian initiative.
becomeDonor.point1Desc: A healthy adult can safely donate blood every 3 to 4 months.
becomeDonor.point2Desc: Help provide timely support when someone in your locality faces a critical blood shortage.
becomeDonor.point3Desc: You have full control to update your donation availability and contact visibility at any time.

trust.sectionSubtitle: RoktoBondhu is a community platform. Mutual respect, privacy, and safety are our highest priorities.
trust.principle1Desc: Never share a donor's contact information publicly or use it for any purpose other than coordinating blood donation.
trust.principle2Desc: Always verify hospital requirements, patient status, and necessary units before finalizing blood donation.
trust.principle3Desc: In critical life-threatening situations, promptly contact local certified blood banks and emergency hospital care.
trust.principle4Desc: Blood donation is purely voluntary. No monetary transaction is endorsed or permitted for blood donations.

finalCta.title: Join the RoktoBondhu Community Today
finalCta.subtitle: Find the right donor when needed, or register as a voluntary donor to help save lives.

donorsPage.title: Find Blood Donors
donorsPage.description: Search for eligible voluntary blood donors across Bangladesh by blood group and locality.

filters.title: Filter Donors
filters.subtitle: Narrow down donors by your required criteria

results.title: Search Results

results.noDonorsFoundDesc: No volunteer donors matched your selected criteria. Try adjusting your blood group or location filters.
results.errorDesc: An unexpected error occurred while fetching donor profiles. Please check your network connection and try again.
results.selfRequestWarning: You cannot request contact from your own profile
results.duplicateRequestWarning: You already have an active contact request with this donor
results.demoNoticeDesc: The platform is currently operating in frontend preview mode. To preserve data integrity and privacy, no fabricated or simulated donor records are displayed. Live donor discovery will be connected to secure databases in an upcoming phase.
results.emptyStateSuggestion: Try selecting different blood group or location parameters.
results.becomeDonorTitle: Want to donate blood and save lives?
results.becomeDonorDesc: Join the RoktoBondhu community as a voluntary donor. A single donation can make a life-saving difference.

bloodRequestsPage.title: Emergency Blood Requests

bloodRequestsPage.createRequestNotice: The live blood request submission form will be connected to our secure database in an upcoming phase.

filters.title: Filter Requests
filters.subtitle: Filter by required blood group, location, or urgency

results.title: Active Blood Requests
results.demoNoticeDesc: The platform is not yet connected to a live database. To prevent misinformation during medical emergencies, no fictitious or mock blood requisitions are displayed.
results.emergencyNoticeDesc: In critical life-threatening situations, promptly contact certified local blood banks and emergency hospital care units directly.

registrationPage.title: Donor Registration
registrationPage.description: Register as a voluntary blood donor and help save lives in critical moments across Bangladesh.
registrationPage.heading: Register as a Blood Donor
registrationPage.subtitle: Provide accurate information to join the voluntary donor network. In an emergency, your single donation can save a life.

form.personalInfoSubtitle: Recipients and coordinators will reach out using this contact information in emergencies
form.namePlaceholder: Enter your full name (e.g. Mohammad Karim)
form.phonePublicHelper: When checked, your phone number will be directly visible in donor search results
form.locationSubtitle: Specify where you are currently located so nearby requests can be routed to you
form.donationSubtitle: Your last donation history and current donation readiness

form.lastDonationDateHelper: Select date (future dates are not allowed)

form.privacyNotice: Privacy & Security Notice: RoktoBondhu strictly prohibits any misuse of contact data. Your information will never be sold or used for commercial purposes.

demoSuccess.title: Registration Preview Complete (Demo Mode)
demoSuccess.desc: Thank you! All submitted information has been successfully validated. The platform is currently operating in frontend preview mode; your personal data has not been saved or transmitted to any server. When database connectivity is activated, your profile will be securely saved.

bloodRequestCreatePage.title: Create Blood Request
bloodRequestCreatePage.description: Submit an urgent blood request with patient and hospital details.
bloodRequestCreatePage.heading: Create a Blood Request
bloodRequestCreatePage.subtitle: Provide accurate requisition details so potential donors in your area can respond swiftly.

emergencyBanner.title: Emergency Medical Alert
emergencyBanner.desc: If the patient is in critical or life-threatening condition, immediately contact National Emergency Service (999) or the nearest hospital blood bank directly.

form.contactHelper: Provide a Bangladeshi phone number that remains reachable 24/7

form.neededAtHelper: When the blood transfusion will be required

form.consentLabel: I certify that this is a genuine medical request for blood, and respectful communication will be maintained with responding donors.

demoSuccess.title: Blood Request Successfully Published!
demoSuccess.desc: Your blood requisition has been saved to the database. You can track, update, or cancel it anytime from your account.

resetPassword.passwordHint: Minimum 8 characters, at least one letter and one number

common.demoNotice: This is a frontend demonstration interface. No backend or Firebase is connected.

contactRequests.pageSubtitle: Manage direct 1-to-1 communication with donors and requesters
contactRequests.consentDialogDesc: Confirm that you want to reveal your personal phone number to this requester for this emergency. Your number will only be shared with this specific person.
contactRequests.noIncomingDesc: When requesters ask to contact you for emergency donations, their requests will appear here for your review.
contactRequests.noOutgoingDesc: Browse the donors directory to find matching blood donors and send direct contact requests.

contactModeSettings.title: Contact Visibility & Privacy
contactModeSettings.description: Control how requesters can reach you when blood is needed.
contactModeSettings.publicDesc: Your phone number is publicly visible on search cards with direct 'Call Now' access. Requesters can dial your phone immediately without prior review.
contactModeSettings.privateDesc: Your phone number is hidden from public searches. Requesters must submit an emergency contact request, which you review and accept before sharing your phone.
contactModeSettings.publicPrivacyWarning: Privacy Notice: In PUBLIC mode, your phone number can be seen by anyone visiting the platform. You can switch back to PRIVATE at any time.
contactModeSettings.contactRequestsDesc: Review incoming requests from patients and track your outgoing donor inquiries
